name: Vietnam War
hook: Saigon, Agent Orange, the Pentagon Papers and the movies that defined America's longest war.

facts.label: Saigon
facts.statement: Saigon was the headquarters of American military operations in South Vietnam; Cam Ranh Bay supplied tens of thousands of U.S. troops.

facts.label: Agent Orange
facts.statement: Agent Orange was the military code name for the herbicide used to defoliate forests; it was linked to three kinds of cancer.

facts.label: the Pentagon Papers
facts.statement: Daniel Ellsberg leaked the Pentagon Papers in 1971 to protest the war and expose policy misconduct.

facts.label: Muhammad Ali
facts.statement: Muhammad Ali was stripped of his title in 1967 for refusing to serve in the Vietnam War.

facts.label: Jimmy Carter
facts.statement: On his first full day as president, Jimmy Carter pardoned most Vietnam War draft evaders in January 1977.

facts.label: John McCain
facts.statement: John McCain was a POW in Hanoi for five and a half years during the war, much of it in solitary confinement.

facts.label: Vietnam War films
facts.statement: Apocalypse Now, The Deer Hunter and Full Metal Jacket are the war's defining films, from the napalm line to Russian roulette.
